nmap.note: TCP connect works unprivileged; raw SYN/OS detection need additional privileges.

curl.note: Guided headers disable redirects and user curl configuration.

openssl.note: Some subcommands are interactive; use the terminal.

httpx-toolkit.note: Preferred Kali executable name; confirm installed version and program rate rules.

httpx.note: May be Python HTTPX, not ProjectDiscovery. Verify identity; prefer httpx-toolkit on Kali.

nuclei.note: Templates, version, scope, rate and program policy need review; no blanket safe template set.

nikto.note: Active checks may be prohibited by individual programs.

ffuf.note: Needs a wordlist, a small traffic budget and explicit program permission.

gobuster.note: Wordlists and request rate must be selected deliberately.

feroxbuster.note: Recursive requests can expand traffic; review scope and limits.

dirsearch.note: Review paths, wordlists and request limits.

whatweb.note: Check probe aggression and program rules.

sqlmap.note: Potentially intrusive; manual scope and method review required.

wpscan.note: Some data/features require a separate API token.

arjun.note: Rate and request volume require review.

katana.note: Headless mode needs a compatible browser; crawling can leave intended scope.

subfinder.note: Some providers need separate API keys; discovered assets are not automatically in scope.

amass.note: Uses data sources and can be resource-intensive; review mode and permissions.

dnsenum.note: Review query volume and third-party queries.

dnsx.note: Verify ARM64 package availability and query rate.

fierce.note: Do not treat newly found infrastructure as authorized.

theHarvester.note: Provider keys and provider restrictions may apply.

recon-ng.note: Interactive workspace; modules/API keys configured separately.

tshark.note: Offline PCAP analysis works unprivileged; live capture needs reviewed capture privileges.

tcpdump.note: Live capture needs permissions and an appropriate interface.

wireshark.note: Requires a desktop; use tshark for terminal-only work.

burpsuite.note: Needs a desktop/browser and possibly a license; Java/browser performance on Pi varies.

zaproxy.note: GUI needs desktop; daemon modes can be invoked manually from the terminal.

firefox-esr.note: Not displayed inside this terminal app; use local desktop or separately secured remote desktop.

chromium.note: ARM package support and sandbox requirements must be checked on the Pi.

msfconsole.note: Interactive framework; database services and module dependencies are separate.

msfdb.note: Database setup is administrative, not automatic.

gdb.note: Debugging/ptrace privileges depend on OS policy.

rizin.note: Use a terminal session for interactive work.

ghidra.note: Requires desktop and a compatible Java runtime; substantial RAM.

binwalk.note: External extraction helpers may need separate packages.

foremost.note: Evidence images and recovered files can use substantial disk space.

vol.note: Symbols, images and package version are separate requirements.

john.note: Compute-heavy; use only approved offline artifacts.

hashcat.note: Pi has no general desktop GPU cracking capability; backend support must be checked.

hydra.note: Online guessing is often prohibited; obtain explicit permission and lockout limits.

aircrack-ng.note: Requires authorized local radio targets and suitable capture files/hardware.

airmon-ng.note: Needs compatible adapter/drivers and privileges; may disrupt networking.

airodump-ng.note: Local radio hardware and monitor-mode privileges required.

bettercap.note: Privileges and network position required; not a HackerOne-wide permission.

responder.note: Needs a suitable authorized network and privileges; not internet bug-bounty default.

netexec.note: Protocol dependencies, credentials and explicit scope required.

smbclient.note: Some modes are interactive; use a terminal.

ldapsearch.note: Credentials, TLS trust and directory scope require configuration.

ssh.note: Outbound SSH is not the Cloudflare web tunnel; review destination separately.

tmux.note: Required for workbench reconnectable terminal sessions.

python3.note: Advanced jobs execute with the service user privileges; not sandboxed.

bash.note: Full native shell access; guided checks do not constrain it.

zsh.note: Full native shell access; guided checks do not constrain it.

git.note: Clone only code you trust; repositories can contain executable hooks/scripts.

htop.note: Runs in a real terminal, not a non-interactive job.

codex.note: Install/authenticate separately; external agent has its own permissions and billing.

claude.note: Install/authenticate separately; not integrated into workbench approval controls.

aider.note: Separate setup, model credentials and behavior apply.
